$comment: Performance budgets for ThumbGate hot paths. Philosophy (2026-08-26, CEO directive): performance is a design constraint, not late-stage cleanup. Instrument before optimizing; fix the largest MEASURED bottleneck. Budgets are p95 milliseconds unless noted. CI applies ciHeadroomMultiplier to absorb shared-runner noise while still catching order-of-magnitude regressions. scripts/perf-budget-check.js is the single measurement tool; PRs touching hotPathFiles must include its output.

hybrid_state_build_ms_p95.what: buildHybridState over a 400-entry feedback log — the slow rebuild path behind PreToolUse guard refresh. Runs on cache miss, so it must stay well under one second of agent-visible stall.

pretool_eval_from_state_ms_p95.what: evaluatePretoolFromState with a warm state — the per-tool-call decision. This taxes EVERY tool call of EVERY fleet agent; 5ms x thousands of calls/day is the whole latency story.

compiled_guard_eval_ms_p95.what: evaluateCompiledGuards against a compiled artifact — the fast path the installed hook uses per invocation.

guard_artifact_compile_ms_p95.what: compileGuardArtifact from a built state — amortized, but blocks the first tool call after a feedback write.

billing_summary_ms_p95.$comment: Measured 15,000ms timeout on 2026-08-26 session bootstrap — the largest known production bottleneck. Requires operator key; probed only with --billing.

unitEconomics.$comment: Cost-per-outcome tracking. Sources already exist; this section names them so reviews cite measurements, not vibes.
